method: Manual inspection of the eight final exact-mesh CPU images and final Canvas plans; not browser screenshots.

reviews.observations: Reviewed final ensemble with the surrounding blocks, roads, separate public park, garden layout and ancillary buildings. No relevant floating geometry or contextual overlap is visible.
Verified three open central entrances after replacing the obstructing frame, continuous base, lateral portico, terrace, roofs and the completed ramp-to-path connection.
Reviewed oval fountain, paths, planting, fence and the completed paved connection to the main entrance. Architecture and terrain meet coherently.
The revised garden-side camera reveals polygonal bay windows on two chalets and keeps the third in the group. Nearby trees and urban facades retain context.
Hall circulation, open door leaves, curved stair, floor and retained ceiling are readable from human eye height.
Nave, central aisle, curved apse, altar and lateral sacristy relationship remain readable. Finishes and furniture are documented as interpretive.
The curved stair, handrail, upper opening and landing remain visible without a near-camera solid obstruction.
Removal of the central upper volume reveals the historical ground-floor fragment. The chapel, hall, stair, open doors and adjoining enclosed wings remain legible.

mapObservations: Mobile label leaders and real anchors remain visible in light and dark themes.
The interior map identifies the historical fragment and uses an approximate scale.
Openings and the curved stair are registered to the implemented model.
correctedIssues: Iterable context exclusions are expanded into individual IDs.
The architectural base closes to the ground.
Fourteen open doors are not blocked by their frames.
The ramp connects to the transverse garden path.
The chalet camera reveals polygonal bay windows.
limitations: CPU sampling grain and approximate lighting do not represent the browser GPU image.
Historical unmeasured elevations, finishes, furniture and tree dimensions remain interpretive.
Browser layout, touch interaction, loaded fonts and GPU performance remain unverified.
